model: CWF BC salmon and steelhead IP (rail connectivity)
quote: Modelled discharge was available for watersheds in the Fraser Basin ... Modelled channel width was used for the remainder of the study area as a surrogate for discharge
note: Modelled MAD (PCIC 2020, Foundry Spatial 2021) in the Fraser and the Bulkley; modelled channel width (Thorley et al. 2021) as the discharge surrogate everywhere else. Not validated: p. 14 says the IP results have not been validated by field assessments.
